verdict.rationale: doola's own dashboard gives digital access to scanned registered-agent mail with secure document storage, which covers the received-documents part of the story. Compliance tracking per company exists only through the Partner API. Partner Portal API keys are developer credentials, not team access to a shared account. Missing for 10: evidence of managing multiple entities from one account, team or multi-user access with permissions, a unified view of state registrations across entities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I manage all entities, state registrations, and received documents from one account my team can access

citations.quote: giving you digital access to physical mail via doola's dashboard
Receive local document scans within the same day and enjoy secure storage for all scanned documents
